Subject: Contract extension & capacity scaling: 64k model + reranker add-on

Diego —

Quick note from our infra/ML team: we’re planning to move a portion of serving to a larger 64k-context model (internally 'g4x-64k') plus a new neural reranker for credit decisioning. That model mix increases peak GPU requirements (longer KV caches + larger activation memory) and changes batching characteristics.

Concretely, our projection for Q4 is: steady-state 12 concurrent heavy-generation workers (64k long-context), burst up to 24 simultaneous long requests during batch reconciliation windows, and steady low-latency reranker traffic that needs dedicated low-quantization capacity.

We’re approaching contract renewal and want to fold dedicated capacity expansion into the renewal to avoid multi-month procurement. Can you send options for term length + reserved pool sizes, expected throughput guarantees (p99/p95), and a pricing delta for:
- baseline: 16 x A100-equivalent GPUs reserved
- expanded: 20 x A100-equivalent GPUs reserved (with priority burst)
- add-on: 'Reranker' bundle (separate pool / lower-quantization profile)

Also need to understand:
- how model mix changes affect the unit-cost token pricing (if we move to the 64k variant),
- whether we can start with 16 and autoscale to 20 within the first 90 days, and
- what the SLA/throughput refund mechanics look like for dedicated pools.

We’re targeting a 12-month extension but open to a 24-month term if you can give meaningful rate protections and capacity guarantees.

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Li
Head of AI Ops, FinTechAI

Thanks Marcus — good summary. I’ve pulled together an initial package and attached a short capacity proposal (capacity_proposal_v3.pdf) and an updated SOW (SOW_FinTechAI_v2.docx). High-level options below so you can review quickly:

Option A — 12-month extension, conservative expansion
- Reserved pool: 16 A100-equivalent GPUs (dedicated)
- Throughput SLO: 95th pct token throughput guarantee at baseline profile (steady 12 heavy-generation workers)
- Reranker add-on: separate 4-GPU pool (quantization profile q5)
- Pricing: baseline + 18% uplift vs current per-token rate to account for 64k memory footprint and additional memory IO
- Provisioning lead time: 3 weeks

Option B — 12-month extension, buffered capacity (recommended)
- Reserved pool: 16 GPUs + 4 GPU burst capacity (reserved for FinTechAI; billed at lower standby rate when idle) -> effective 20 GPUs available on demand
- Throughput SLOs: 95th pct + dedicated burst assurances (only for capacity at reserved levels)
- Reranker add-on: integrated into the buffered pool for lower cross-pool latency
- Pricing: baseline + 22% uplift; includes a one-time expedited provisioning fee to stand up burst pool in 2 weeks

Option C — 24-month term (best rate protection)
- Same as Option B with a 10% credit on the annualized commitment and lower per-token uplifts

Notes on flexibility:
- Mid-term scale-to-add GPUs: we can support staged expansions; provisioning time varies (2–4 weeks) depending on hardware availability. We’ll include an express expansion path in the SOW for an extra fee to guarantee sub-10 business day turn-up.
- Model mix pricing: larger-context models count against the same per-token metering but the uplift covers the sustained memory and KV cache costs; we can gate the larger model behind a usage cap for predictable billing.
- SLA and refunds: p95/p99 latency/throughput credits are specified in the attached SOW; typical remedies are service credits for missed SLOs tied to the dedicated pool.

Next steps: please confirm which option you prefer and whether you want the express provisioning clause. If you’re good, I’ll route the SOW for signature (DocuSign) and circle up infra for provisioning windows.
